expressions.title: The National Book Foundation Ordinance, 1972
expressions.title_basis: p1 blocks 1583432-1583435 print 'THE NATIONAL BOOK FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1972. / ORDINANCE No. XXVI OF 1972 / [4th July 1972] An Ordinance to establish an organization ...'; s.1(1) (p2 block 1583443) 'This Ordinance may be called the National Book Foundation Ordinance, 1972'; complete in ss.1-5 (block 1583458). The catalogue's number XXV is the preceding Ordinance's. The later National Book Foundation Act, 1972 (XIX of 1972) is a different law (document 2093).

expressions.title: The Pakistan Citizenship (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
expressions.title_basis: p1 blocks 1583412-1583415 print 'THE PAKISTAN CITIZENSHIP (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972. / ORDINANCE No. XXV OF 1972 / [30th June, 1972] / An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951.'; s.1(1) (block 1583420) 'This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Citizenship (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972'; complete in ss.1-2 (to block 1583431, clause (c) of the substituted sub-section (2) of section 14). Its first span opens at the page's running head (blocks 1583409-1583411); its footnote 1 'Since repealed by the Pakistan Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 1972 (17 of 1972), s. 4.' (block 1583436) is its second span. Not held elsewhere (title search 'citizenship').
